## Context / Problem

ADR 0116 authorized clean pre-1.0 removal of eight old env/config spellings after runtime work landed. Upstream `7370-0274-9f80-437d` has landed on current `origin/main` (5ae93de838af) and already removed the active code aliases. Sibling `038d` was found obsolete because that landed change removed all eight aliases from code. This ticket publishes the remaining documentation/changelog surface so operators see canonical spellings and the migration mapping instead of live-alias guidance.

## Current-main validity assessment

On current `origin/main`, `docs/env-vars.md`, `docs/config-reference.md`, `docs/api-stability.md`, `tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py`, and `tests/golden/config_surface.json` are already regenerated/aligned/canonical for the removed aliases and should be validated, not hand-edited. Remaining gaps are hand-authored narrative/release surfaces and one env-registry regression expectation:

- `docs/config.md` still presents the eight names as permanent/live aliases in example comments and Back-compat prose.
- `docs/bash-migration.md` and `docs/concurrency.md` still mention `REBAR_NO_SYNC` as a live opt-out alias.
- `docs/release-notes.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` need a release/changelog entry that names every removed spelling and canonical replacement; existing older release-note statements that say the aliases are still honored must be corrected as historical release notes.
- `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py` already retains an explicit absent-from-generated-docs expectation for all seven removed env spellings; keep it green as validation evidence.

## Approach

Update only the recorded file-impact paths. Regenerate generated surfaces only through their sanctioned generator if drift appears; otherwise leave already-regenerated generated files untouched and prove drift tests pass. Directly edit hand-authored docs/release notes to replace live-alias guidance with canonical-only configuration guidance and explicit ADR 0116 migration text. Run a full string census across the eight retired spellings and classify remaining occurrences as intentional tests, ADR/history, or migration documentation.

## Scope

- `docs/env-vars.md`, `docs/config.md`, `docs/config-reference.md`, `docs/bash-migration.md`, `docs/concurrency.md`, `docs/api-stability.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`
- `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py`, `tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py`, and `tests/golden/config_surface.json`
- sanctioned generators only if those generated/golden surfaces drift

## Testing

- RED-first documentation oracle: a complete-population census/check that fails while live-alias guidance remains and while the changelog/release notes lack all eight ADR 0116 mappings.
- Targeted generated-surface checks: `pytest tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py`.
- Full local gates required for this ticket: `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test` (with only documented local macOS deselections if needed).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Live documentation and examples use only canonical spellings for the eight removed env/config names.
- [ ] Generated env/config reference surfaces and their tests are regenerated or verified so they no longer present the old names as live aliases.
- [ ] Release/changelog documentation names every removal and its canonical replacement.
- [ ] A full string census of the eight removed spellings leaves only intentional tombstones, the new ADR, explicit migration documentation, regression tests, or clearly historical references.
